synonyms: dry spell; water deficit; aridity; water stress

definition: Drought defined by a period with an abnormal precipitation deficit relative to the long-term average for a region.

adaptation_condition: Intrinsic

adaptation_condition: Intrinsic

adaptation_condition: Intrinsic

adaptation_condition: Intrinsic

adaptation_condition: Intrinsic

synonyms: Erratic rainfall; intra-seasonal variability; rainfall uncertainty; irregular precipitation
definition: Form of rainfall variability characterised by unpredictable within-season timing, frequency, intensity, or spatial distribution of precipitation, which disrupts crop calendars and farm decisions; distinct from a lasting change in season timing and from sustained shortage or excess.

adaptation_condition: Intrinsic
